artDirection: Premium painted HD-2D fantasy tactical RPG departure at the canonical Lion field camp. Alistair and Seraphine are grounded inside a living dawn environment with subtle depth, cloth movement, firelight, dust and foreground parallax. This is the first forward campaign beat after the chronicle, not a replay of the prologue.

cast.truthBasis: Alistair is a guaranteed core hero; Seraphine is the authored camp adviser in the existing cinematic plan.

shots.purpose: Establish the company at the camp-road threshold preparing to depart.
shots.promptIntent: Alistair settles his weight toward the road while Seraphine gives a small acknowledgement. Keep both feet anchored and scale constant. Make the world breathe through restrained banner and tent-cloth movement, distant smoke, warm fire flicker, drifting dust, and a slow foreground-layer parallax; never move the whole painted background as one flat sheet.

shots.purpose: Show a short grounded first step, then stop ready for the next Journey boundary.
shots.promptIntent: Alistair performs one short believable planted step toward screen-right, with clear weight transfer, foot lift, heel-to-ground contact, matching root motion under four percent of frame width, then stops. Do not produce a long walk or sliding glide. Seraphine only shifts her stance and remains at the same depth. Lock apparent character scale and camera distance. Use independent subtle banner, tent cloth, smoke, dust, firelight, and foreground parallax motion so the camp feels alive rather than a moving wallpaper. End stable with important faces above the lower agency-safe zone.
